title: Customer need strata and action bulletin (Oct 2026)
content:
Purpose

Short synthesis of customer feedback collected Aug–Sep 2026, turned into actionable request strata and a compact set of recommended next steps. This is an operational bulletin intended for product, engineering PMs, and solutions engineering to align on quick probes vs. roadmap asks.

Method + signals
- Sources: support tickets (priority-tagged), CSM post-call notes, enterprise onboarding surveys, field interviews (n=12), telemetry: spike in latency alerts for streaming endpoints in us-west2 during 99th pct loads.
- Triage approach: grouped asks into 3 strata (Immediate, Near-term, Strategic). Scoring = (customer impact * frequency * deploy-effort multiplier). Rough probability bands applied where customer urgency varied.

Strata: definitions
- Immediate (P0): fixes or UX changes that unblock paying customers or are causing active churn signals. Low dev effort (<= 2 sprints) and high visibility.
- Near-term (P1): enhancements that materially improve unit economics or reliability for multiple customers; moderate effort (2–6 sprints).
- Strategic (P2): platform capabilities or policy changes requiring cross-team design (OPT, Serving, Console), long lead time.

Top asks (annotated)
1) Streaming token gap: intermittent “stalled” events when switching model variants mid-stream (customer quote: “stream freezes when we fallback to smaller model”).
   - Impact: Immediate for a subset of enterprise customers using canary/fallback routing.
   - Observed telemetry: session splice errors correlate with fallback events and KV-cache misses.
   - Suggested action: hotpatch in routing layer to prefer graceful cutover (buffered tail tokens + synthetic EOS) as quick guardrail. Owner: eng-serving-runtime. Est effort: 3 dev-days for a guardrail, 2 sprints for robust fix. Tags: streaming, routing. Recommended priority: Immediate. Linked: JIRA RDW-2147.

2) Token billing transparency at route level (customers want per-route token breakdowns instead of pooled billing).
   - Impact: High for finance teams; repeated ask from 4 enterprise accounts.
   - Quick win: expose route-level token view in Console usage tab (frontend + small API addition).
   - Longer: CSV export + SLA-linked billing dimensions. Est effort: 1 sprint (UI) + 1 backend spike. Owner: product-console. Priority: Near-term.

3) Preferential batching controls for Dedicated pools (customers want deterministic latency for priority traffic).
   - Impact: Platform teams and high-throughput customers.
   - Ask: ability to set per-API-key latency-target and have routing respect capacity tiers (i.e., small fast batch size for priority).
   - Risk: scheduling complexity; could reduce overall throughput.
   - Proposal: incubate as a feature-flagged policy on Dedicated (config by pool). Est effort: 6–8 sprints; cross-team. Priority: Strategic.

4) SDK error granularity: most language SDKs return opaque 5xx without retry hints.
   - Field quotes: “We don’t know whether to backoff or fail fast.”
   - Quick patch: add standard error codes and suggested retry/backoff metadata (clientlib surface). Est effort: 1–2 weeks per SDK. Owner: developer-experience. Priority: Immediate.

5) KV/prefix cache observability: customers using long context chains want per-session cache hit rates in Console.
   - Impact: Observability -> directly tied to cost and latency debugging.
   - Proposal: surface per-session cache-hit %, sample traces for heavy users. Est effort: 3 sprints. Priority: Near-term.

Micro-vignettes (illustrative)
- Finance team at FinStart: refused rollout due to inability to attribute tokens to feature routes; asked for CSV export and per-route SLA.
- AI Ops at RetailCo: saw 15% latency spikes during peak; workaround was to reduce batch size, which doubled cost. Wants deterministic priority lanes.
- Gov client: requires KMS audit events tied to each model invocation — recurring ask for Private deployments only.

Quick-play ledger (things we can do in next 30 days)
- Implement SDK error metadata (owner: devexp) -> deliverable: error spec + soft-rollout in node/python SDK (2 weeks).
- Console token export MVP (owner: product-console) -> wireframe + API contract (1 sprint).
- Streaming fallback guardrail (owner: serving-runtime) -> implement buffered tail + metrics (3 business days for pilot).
- Field-signal mailbox: set up recurring 2-week digest to CS -> product (owner: Aisha) to prevent duplicate asks slipping into backlog.

Risk notes + tradeoffs
- Prioritizing per-route billing will require billing infra work; short-term we can surface usage without changing invoicing by adding a labeled view.
- Preferential batching reduces gross throughput; must be opt-in at pool level and monitored for unit-cost inflation.
- Exposing cache hit rates has PII considerations for session traces; ensure sampling and redaction policy.

Open questions for PM sync (next Wed)
- How many customers need true per-route billing vs. just visibility? (CS to enumerate 6 accounts by EOD Tue)
- Can Dedicated pools accept policy flags without infra refactor? (infra validation request: RDW-2201)
- What is acceptable telemetry retention for cache traces in Console (SRE + Security to weigh in)?

Suggested owners & next steps
- Fast patches (0–30 days): SDK errors (devexp), streaming guardrail (serving-runtime), token-view wireframe (product-console).
- Mid runway (1–3 months): console CSV export, cache-hit surface (observability + serving-runtime).
- Long runway (Q1+): preferential batching for Dedicated, per-route invoicing (billing).

Appendix: raw snippets from field notes
- “When we hit a burst, the stream just stops and we retry — customers see truncated responses.” — RetailCo SRE
- “If you can give me per-feature token numbers I can make this cost-neutral to my execs.” — FinStart Head of ML
- “We need explicit guidance on SDK retries — our engineers are implementing homegrown exponential backoffs.” — Startup CTO

Files to attach / links (work in progress)
- RDW-2147 (streaming fallback) — linked, working spec in Confluence.
- Draft wireframes for token export: https://confluence.redwood/console/token-export-draft (WIP)
- Slack threads: #cs-field-voices (search thread 558)

Notes to self
- Push for a small observable experiment for cache-hit surface: sample 1% of sessions for 4 weeks and present cost/impact.
- Request a short postmortem + timeline from serving SRE on the us-west2 spike.

-- Aisha (CS lead)
